metadata.scenario_disclaimer: Decision-support scenario screening comparing 2026 KTMB OD demand against published GTFS reference schedules and official 2023 nominal train capacities (SCS=1,118 pax; Komuter Utara 3-car EMU=400 pax). Not physical onboard load measurement. Klang Valley uses the November 2026 GTFS reference timetable (excluding unverified 2026-11-09 holiday from matched checks); Komuter Utara adopts symmetric 50/50 bounded mixed matching with full scenario uncertainty range exposed.
